dogecoin.text: In the interim, users leverage third-party apps like MyDoge Wallet and sodogetip to transact DOGE on X, and many anticipate official support by late 2024 . Cardano co-founder Charles Hoskinson even publicly teased a proposal to enable Dogecoin payments,

the Dogecoin community has rapidly mobilized for native DOGE tipping. Founder Billy Markus (“Shibetoshi Nakamoto”) endorsed integrating DOGE into X’s Tips feature, arguing that Dogecoin’s active on-platform use makes it a logical addition .

Alongside currency tips, X rolled out hexagon-shaped NFT profile pictures that verify on-chain ownership through OpenSea, opening a pathway for NFT-based monetization and identity authentication .
